summary: stui records what each send cost on this device (to pending draw, to st's answer, to delivered) in a local file of milliseconds and ids

schema.detail: No tables, columns, indexes or triggers.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digests are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: No wire or product behavior change: a bounded local diagnostic file, never sent anywhere, no message text and no person or agent names.

recovery.detail: Delete the file to clear it.
